# Read in the temperature data

Data downloaded from: https://portal.edirepository.org/nis/mapbrowse?scope=knb-lter-mcr&identifier=1035&revision=20 on November 11, 2026

**Recommended citation:**

Moorea Coral Reef LTER, J. Leichter, T. Adam, and H. Krumbholz. 2026. MCR LTER: Coral Reef: Benthic Water Temperature, ongoing since 2005 ver 20. Environmental Data Initiative. https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/bb8cb2232b3d00e445ece285c1f76f03 (Accessed 2026-11-11).

**NOTE:** You will need to download these files off of EDI (see link above and then download the `MCR Bottom-Mounted Thermistor Zip File`) and put them into the `raw_data` folder.
